cycle_report.summary: Cycle 1 completed a comprehensive audit and test enhancement of invoke_llm()'s new tuple-return signature. All five mission tasks were completed with perfect scores: (1) grepped all test files and confirmed no stale single-value return patterns; (2) audited all mock setups — existing mocks already use correct tuple unpacking; (3) added 40 integration tests exercising invoke_llm through classify_error(), extract_json(), retry logic, and concurrency paths; (4) added 27 Hypothesis property-based tests validating tuple structure invariants across generated inputs; (5) achieved 100% branch coverage on invoke_llm (lines 466-600), exceeding the >90% target. An additional 53-test adversarial/red-team suite was built from a fresh perspective. Total: 169 new tests + 331 existing af_engine tests = 500 passing tests.
